name: Microbiology PhD

english.toefl: 81 for tests beforeJanuary2026;4.5 for tests afterJanuary2026
english.note: University IELTS minimum7 overall with no subscore below6; PTE68 overall with no subscore below58. Program requirements may be higher. Country/qualifying-degree exemptions apply; see the central policy. The department describes TOEFL100 or IELTS8 as qualities of the strongest international applicants, not admission minima.

applicationFee.note: International fee100USD; domestic fee60USD. Central policy expressly excludes international fee waivers. Reimbursement after an invited, completed interview is a separate process; confirm whether it covers international applicants.

requirements.note: Minimum GPA3.00/4 or foreign equivalent. Department says all invited applicants completing interview receive fee reimbursement, while separately excluding international fee waivers; confirm reimbursement eligibility before relying on it.

detailsNote: Current priority deadline confirmed; the admissions model is not established by the opened admissions pages.

funding.note: All Microbiology PhD students are financially supported. July2026–June2027 stipend36350 plus tuition/mandatory fees and health/dental benefits; support beyond year1 requires satisfactory progress.
